invariants.rationale: Average record size and sizes returned from configuration or computed are always non-negative.
If timeline is empty, result is always the config estimate. If not, it could be overridden.
Average record size should not exceed the configured small file limit.
If there are no past instants, only config value is used, ensuring result is not lower than estimate.
The method never returns Long.MAX_VALUE; the computation uses smaller positive long values.
